_readme: Choices parked on the owner that have no config file of their own (lib/parked.py, marvin#1222). Each names its decision ticket (with a Decisions block) and a review-by date at most 7 days out; the hourly scan puts a due one back in Needs you, and Health row parked:overdue shows it.

outcome_check_block.what: refuse a fix with no outcome check (lib/fit_check.py)
